data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fatha' which means 'to open'. Fathiyya refers to an opener, one who opens the way for others or sheds light on hidden truths. The name Fathiyya carries the meaning “Opening, Opener” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fathiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody opening, opener and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fathiyya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
